Identifier.description: Identifier of the reservation within the transaction.

State.description: State of the newly created reservation (either `Optional`, `Enquired` or `Confirmed`). If not specified, `Confirmed` is used.

StartUtc.description: Reservation start in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

EndUtc.description: Reservation end in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

ReleasedUtc.description: Release date and time of an unconfirmed reservation in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

PersonCounts.description: Number of people per age category the reservation was booked for. At least one category with valid count must be provided.

CustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the `Customer` who owns the reservation.

BookerId.description: Unique identifier of the `Customer` on whose behalf the reservation was made.

AssignedResourceLocked.description: Whether the reservation should be locked to the assigned `Resource`. (`null` or `false` if the reservation should not be locked)

VoucherCode.description: Voucher code value providing access to specified private `Rate` applied to this reservation.

CreditCardId.description: Identifier of `CreditCard` belonging either to the `Customer` who owns the reservation or to the `Booker`.

TravelAgencyId.description: Identifier of the `Company` that mediated the reservation.

CompanyId.description: Identifier of the `Company` on behalf of which the reservation was made.

TimeUnitAmount.title: Amount parameters
TimeUnitAmount.description: Amount of each night of the reservation.

TimeUnitPrices.description: Prices for time units of the reservation. E.g. prices for the first or second night.

ProductOrders.description: Parameters of the products ordered together with the reservation.

AvailabilityBlockId.description: Unique identifier of the `AvailabilityBlock` the reservation is assigned to.
